item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00110","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C12","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 is a clear material drafting precursor. The child returns to the same Commission, the same failed bill, the same conflict-of-interest obstacle, and the same submitted resignations, then reuses distinctive formulations from C20 about the difficulty of obtaining qualified members, balancing internal security with individual rights, Congress being “as anxious as I am,” and the stated purpose being important but not exclusive. The child effectively updates C20’s appeal for legislation after Congress adjourned without acting. C12 supplied the underlying description of the Commission’s mission, while C10 closely relates to the final discussion of continued review by the National Security Council and Civil Service Commission, but neither matches C20’s extensive language and argumentative sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Failure of the Senate to pass H.R. 2829, a bill which would have exempted members and employees of the Commission from certain conflict-of-interest statutes, has not only led to the resignation of the present members of the Commission, it also makes it virtually impossible to appoint new Commission members or staff members.","parent_excerpt":"I am writing to request that the Senate Committee on the Judiciary give further consideration to H.R. 2829, to exempt the members and certain employees of the Commission on Internal Security and Individual Rights from the operation of certain conflict-of-interest statutes. It has become apparent that this Commission, as it is presently constituted, cannot effectively perform its functions unless such legislation as this is passed. ... the members of the Commission are submitting their resignations to me.","explanation":"The child updates the precise legislative problem and its consequences first laid out in C20."},{"child_excerpt":"It would be extremely difficult m select a Commission of the kind which should be chosen for this task without including members whose private business or professional activities might result in a technical violation of those statutes.","parent_excerpt":"In a time of national emergency like the present, it becomes more essential than ever to allow the Government to avail itself of the services and advice of patriotic and public spirited citizens who might be technically barred from service because of these statutes.","explanation":"Both explain that technical application of the conflict-of-interest statutes prevents recruitment of the distinguished private citizens needed for the Commission."},{"child_excerpt":"I had hoped that the Congress would be as anxious as I am to make sure that our procedures for maintaining the security of the Government service are working effectively. I had hoped that the Congress would be as anxious as I am to make sure that the Bill of Rights is not undermined in our eagerness to stamp out subversive activities. These were not the only purposes for which the Commission on Internal Security and Individual Rights was established, but they were among the most important.","parent_excerpt":"It seems to me that the Congress would be as anxious as I am to make sure that there are no communists or other subversives in the Government employ. While this was not the only purpose for which this Commission was created, surely it is one of the most important.","explanation":"This is distinctive near-verbatim reuse, expanded in the child to emphasize both security and individual rights."},{"child_excerpt":"Under the Executive Order establishing the Commission, its job was to make a thorough examination of the laws, practices, and procedures which protect our Nation against treason, espionage, sabotage, and other subversive activities. The Commission was to consider these matters from the standpoint of protecting the rights of our individual citizens as well as security of the United States.","parent_excerpt":"The purpose of this Commission is to make recommendations concerning the problems involved in providing for the internal security of the United States and at the same time protecting the rights and freedoms of individuals.","explanation":"C20 and the child share the same paired formulation of national security and individual rights, with the child elaborating it from the establishing order."}]}
